HEY KREWE - SADDLE UP

The warning phase is over.

We gave you absurdly early notice. Now the Jazz Fest 2027 lineup is officially out, official ticket options are worth checking now, and nearby places are only going to get harder to find. In other words: this is the part where Pokey starts yelling.

Jazz Fest 2027: April 22-25 and April 29-May 2 at the Fair Grounds. Our Krewe HQ is at 2813 Ursulines Avenue in Bayou St. John - about five blocks away.

The Music

Both weekends are stacked.

Weekend One

April 22-25, 2027
Foo Fighters | The Who | James Taylor & His All Star Band | Jack White | Widespread Panic | Chaka Khan | Khruangbin | The War on Drugs | The Avett Brothers | Train | The Meters | Warren Haynes Band | PJ Morton

Plus Samantha Fish, Tank and the Bangas, Dirty Dozen Brass Band, Dumpstaphunk, Big Sam's Funky Nation, Kermit Ruffins, Anders Osborne and a ridiculous amount more.

Weekend Two

April 29-May 2, 2027
Noah Kahan | Brandi Carlile | Gwen Stefani | Jack Johnson | Matchbox Twenty | LL Cool J | The B-52s | Buddy Guy | Trombone Shorty & Orleans Avenue | The Revivalists | Irma Thomas | Galactic | The Radiators 2.0

Plus Preservation Hall Jazz Band, Big Freedia, Molly Tuttle, Cory Wong, George Porter Jr., Rebirth Brass Band, Jon Cleary, Tab Benoit and many, many more.
Krewe note: The Radiators 2.0 are on Weekend Two. This is not a drill.

Official 2027 lineup artwork from the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival. View the full official lineup ->

Why 2027 Is Extra Special

The official poster is The Radiators.

The 2027 Jazz Fest poster is "Glowing Up Together: Tipitina's & The Radiators @ 50" by Paul Rogers. It celebrates fifty years of Tipitina's and the fish-head universe that grew up around The Radiators.

This one is especially meaningful to the Krewe: The Radiators are the fully endorsed band of the Krewe of Pokey, the poster celebrates them, and The Radiators 2.0 are actually playing Weekend Two. Sometimes the universe gets the memo.

03 · FOR THE TRULY BOLD

The WWOZ Brass Pass

ON SALE NOW — for the eight-day warriors and clever Krewe collaborators. The WWOZ Brass Pass provides admission to both weekends of Jazz Fest, same-day exit and re-entry privileges, and access to the WWOZ Hospitality Tent. Coming for just one weekend? Coordinate with another Krewe member attending the opposite weekend and split the cost. Brass Passes are transferable between festival days: different people can use the same pass on different days, but only one person may use it on any given day. Your purchase also supports WWOZ, New Orleans community radio. Check WWOZ for current pricing, availability and full pass terms.
